Name: LanceNoShirt (Content Patcher)
Author: dedpeech
Description:
This content pack provides an alternate portrait and sprite for Lance (SVE is required) to appear shirtless all the time. Got this idea from reddit user u/Durrmatohead468 while on the goofy grass late at night.

Simply download, unzip, and place in your mod folder! I made/tested this with version 1.6 of Stardew Valley, so I'm not sure how it would work with older versions.

This is my first ever mod, so if it doesn't work for you, please be patient with me <3

Downloads.Description: Simply download, unzip, and place in mods folder!
